items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: we knew that Ed Foxx was going to try to cause some trouble

ctx.x: That's right. And so we knew see, we were beginning to think in these days a little bit now, we knew that Ed Foxx was going to try to cause some trouble. So in the meantime we had memorized a book, we had rehearsed so much that we memorized the book and we had the music locked up at the Ritz Hotel. So when we played this dance that night, Ed Foxx had sent the police up there to take all of the music. Now, Walter Fuller and the others all that split, they didn't have any music, see. We were hip enough to get that…
were going to find some music on the stand so they could confiscate it, we were up there with no music playing the repertoire.
